$hardcodedCodeNote: Two kinds of entry live below, and the difference matters. A DATA entry is permanent: the literal is scenario content, a backend contract value or a sample in the language of the data, and translating it would be wrong. A DEBT entry is a ratchet at its measured value: it is real French chrome that nobody has moved to a key yet, the number may only go down, and the entry is deleted when it reaches zero. Never turn a DEBT entry into a DATA entry to make the guard green.
